turns: What data do we have in the lakehouse? Give me an overview.

facts.label: dataset
facts.sql: SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM lake.`bronze_meta.dataset_catalog` UNION ALL SELECT title FROM lake.`bronze_meta_sec.dataset_catalog`)

turns: How many foreign tourist visits were recorded in 2024?

facts.label: total
facts.sql: SELECT sum(jumlah) FROM serving.mart_wisman WHERE tahun = 2024

turns: Which three countries sent the most foreign tourists over the whole period, and how many each?

facts.label: country
facts.sql: SELECT negara FROM serving.mart_wisman GROUP BY negara ORDER BY sum(jumlah) DESC LIMIT 3

facts.label: visits
facts.sql: SELECT sum(jumlah) s FROM serving.mart_wisman GROUP BY negara ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 3

turns: By what percentage did foreign tourist visits grow from 2023 to 2024?

facts.label: growth %
facts.sql: SELECT round(100 * (sumIf(jumlah, tahun = 2024) - sumIf(jumlah, tahun = 2023)) / sumIf(jumlah, tahun = 2023), 2) FROM serving.mart_wisman

turns: Which month of 2024 had the most foreign tourist visits, and how many were there?

facts.label: visits
facts.sql: SELECT sum(jumlah) s FROM serving.mart_wisman WHERE tahun = 2024 GROUP BY bulan_no ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

facts.label: month
facts.sql: SELECT arrayElement(['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'], toUInt8(bulan_no)) FROM (SELECT bulan_no, sum(jumlah) s FROM serving.mart_wisman WHERE tahun = 2024 GROUP BY bulan_no ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1)

turns: Which tourist attraction had the highest total number of visits, and what was the total?

facts.label: attraction
facts.sql: SELECT destinasi FROM serving.mart_kunjungan_dtw ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

facts.label: total
facts.sql: SELECT total FROM serving.mart_kunjungan_dtw ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

turns: Which tourist attraction has the highest share of foreign visitors, and what is that share as a percentage?

facts.label: attraction
facts.sql: SELECT destinasi FROM serving.mart_kunjungan_dtw ORDER BY wisman / total DESC LIMIT 1

facts.label: share %
facts.sql: SELECT round(100 * wisman / total, 1) FROM serving.mart_kunjungan_dtw ORDER BY wisman / total DESC LIMIT 1

turns: How did the number of tourism events change between 2020 and 2024?

facts.label: events
facts.sql: SELECT jumlah_event FROM serving.mart_event WHERE tahun IN (2020, 2024) ORDER BY tahun

turns: Which tourism competitiveness readiness indicators have no data available yet? How many are there?

facts.label: indicator
facts.sql: SELECT indikator FROM serving.mart_gci_readiness WHERE data_tersedia = 0

facts.label: count
facts.sql: SELECT count() FROM serving.mart_gci_readiness WHERE data_tersedia = 0

turns: Provinsi mana yang punya usaha kuliner terdaftar paling banyak, dan berapa jumlahnya?

facts.label: province
facts.sql: SELECT wilayah FROM serving.mart_kuliner ORDER BY jumlah_usaha DESC LIMIT 1

facts.label: count
facts.sql: SELECT jumlah_usaha FROM serving.mart_kuliner ORDER BY jumlah_usaha DESC LIMIT 1

turns: What columns does the monthly foreign tourist data have, and what does each one mean?

facts.label: column
facts.sql: SELECT name FROM system.columns WHERE database = 'serving' AND table = 'mart_wisman' AND name NOT LIKE '\_%'

turns: How many points of interest are in the tourism atlas in total, and which category has the most?

facts.label: total
facts.sql: SELECT sum(jumlah_poi) FROM serving.mart_atlas

facts.label: category
facts.sql: SELECT kategori FROM serving.mart_atlas ORDER BY jumlah_poi DESC LIMIT 1
